about: 16 labelled DM threads, 2 per class, for build step 9. Each thread lists the messages oldest first, the class Claude should assign, the expected handling, and sample drafts that the draft-import validator must accept (good_draft) or reject (bad_drafts). Handling: send = a normal reply is drafted and sent; price = a reply with the offer link and no number; escalate = no reply, goes to needs-you; dnc = do_not_contact, no reply; skip = no reply needed, thread closed quietly.

messages.text: Thanks for connecting, Dana. Your comment on outbound for agencies stuck with me. How are you filling the pipeline right now?
Mostly referrals honestly. Would love something more predictable, what do you do?

threads.good_draft: Referrals are great until they dry up. We set up outbound that books calls for agencies like yours. Want me to show you how it would look for your niche?

bad_drafts.body: We help agencies book calls. Grab a time here https://example.com/book
Our package is $1,500 per month and books 10 calls. Interested?

messages.text: Hey Raj, saw your take on cold email deliverability. What's the biggest headache on your side right now?
